scripts.bundle:android: react-native bundle --platform android --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output build/android/index.bundle --assets-dest build/android
scripts.bundle:ios: react-native bundle --platform ios --dev false --entry-file index.js --bundle-output build/ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest build/ios
scripts.test: pnpm bundle:android && pnpm bundle:ios && node --test test/bundles.test.mjs
